In the latter part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] a '''prototype heavy repeater''' was developed but never saw general production. [[Canderous Ordo]] owned and carried one when an [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] first encountered him in the [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] [[Lower City]].
